format: traditional Full Shop (typically about 800 sq ft in a high-traffic or retail mall area)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a traditional Shop (a "Full Shop") ranges from $157,795 to $835,500. This includes $35,659 to $59,567 that must be paid to us or our affiliates.

fee.quote: When you sign a Franchise Agreement, you must pay us an initial franchise fee (the "Initial Franchise Fee") of $35,500 for a Full Shop, $10,500 for a Concession Shop, $71,000 for a Cinnabon Co-Branded Shop ($35,500 of which will be paid to Cinnabon)
fee.note: VetFran: Initial Franchise Fee for a Full Shop is $20,000 for qualifying veterans or members of the Armed Forces. May be reduced case by case (additional Shops, reopening closed Shops, etc.); in 2025 franchisees paid $5,250 to $28,500. Concession Shop $10,500; co-branded $71,000.

royalty.quote: Royalty Fee Currently, 7% of Net Sales, which we may increase in our sole discretion to 8% of Net Sales, for all Shops except: ...

adFund.quote: Advertising Contribution Shops in Other Locations (except Co-Branded Shops in Other Locations): Currently, 2% of Net Sales ... Shops in Streetside Locations: Currently, 3% of Net Sales.
adFund.note: 2% for Other Locations (malls, airports etc.), 3% for Streetside Locations. Local Marketing Obligation currently not less than 1% of Net Sales; Advertising Contribution plus Local Marketing Obligation may not exceed 5% of Net Sales.

otherRecurring.name: POS System License and Lease Fees
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, $159 to $397 per month (CapEx Program) and $302 to $967 per month (HaaS Program)

otherRecurring.name: Online ordering fee
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, $54 per month, plus a per transaction fee (currently, 0.04% per transaction)

otherRecurring.name: Ordering Support Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, 3% of the pre-tax transaction amount for each transaction that is processed through our online ordering

transferFee.amount: 50% of the then-current Initial Franchise Fee if it is a Control Transfer; if it is a transfer to a related party or that is not a Control Transfer, 10% of the then-current Initial Franchise Fee.

Excludes streetside, strip malls, Walmarts, universities, concession shops, other co-branded and affiliate-owned shops.

special: Royalty is currently 7% but can be raised to 8% at franchisor's discretion; ad contribution higher (3%) for Streetside Locations. Ordering Support Fee of 3% of online transactions. Item 7 includes only one month of rent and excludes purchase of real estate. Co-branded formats (Cinnabon, Jamba) pay a second franchisor's royalty on that brand's share of sales.
